top_signals.title: Soil from decontamination work in Fukushima to be reused in regional cities
top_signals.summary: The government decided to begin reusing the soil for flowerbeds at buildings in Sendai in Miyagi Prefecture, and in Saitama, where central government branch offices are located.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
